translations.de: Das Praktischste am Leben in Taiwan ist, dass es alle paar Schritte einen Supermarkt gibt; ob Pakete versenden oder Geld abheben, alles ist extrem bequem!

sentences.ko_full: 대만 생활에서 가장 편리한 점은 몇 걸음만 걸으면 편의점이 있다는 것이며, 택배를 보내든 돈을 찾든 정말 편리합니다!
sentences.pt_full: A parte mais prática de morar em Taiwan é ter uma loja de conveniência a cada passo; seja para enviar encomendas ou sacar dinheiro, é super cômodo!

translations.tr: Tayvanlı arkadaşım bana sıcak bir şekilde: 'Vaktin olunca sık sık eve oturmaya gel!' dedi.
translations.en: My Taiwanese friend warmly told me: 'Whenever you're free, come over to hang out!'
translations.es: Mi amigo taiwanés me dijo amablemente: '¡Cuando tengas tiempo, pásate por mi casa!'

translations.en: My Taiwanese friend warmly told me: 'Whenever you're free, come over to hang out!'

sentences.en_full: Jiufen Old Street leans against mountains facing the sea; when red lanterns light up, the night view is enchanting.
sentences.grammar_tip: Jiufen (九份) is a historic mountain town in Ruifang famous for teahouses, taro balls (芋圓), and Miyazaki-like red lanterns.

translations.tr: Jiufen Eski Caddesi dağa yaslanıp denize bakar, kırmızı fenerler yandığında gece manzarası olağanüstü büyüleyicidir.
translations.en: Jiufen Old Street leans against mountains facing the sea; when red lanterns light up, the night view is enchanting.
translations.es: La calle antigua de Jiufen bordea el mar y la montaña; cuando se encienden los farolillos rojos, la vista nocturna es mágica.
translations.de: Die Altstadt von Jiufen liegt zwischen Bergen und Meer; wenn die roten Laternen leuchten, ist die Nachtaussicht bezaubernd.
translations.fr: La vieille rue de Jiufen flirte avec la mer et la montagne ; quand les lanternes rouges s'allument, la vue nocturne est féerique.
translations.it: La vecchia strada di Jiufen si affaccia tra mare e monti; quando le lanterne rosse si accendono, la vista notturna è incantevole.
translations.ja: 九份の古い街並みは山を背に海に面しており、赤い提灯が灯る夜景は特に魅惑的です。
translations.ko: 지우펀 옛 거리는 산을 등지고 바다를 품고 있어, 붉은 홍등이 켜지는 야경이 무척 매혹적입니다.
translations.pt: A rua antiga de Jiufen fica entre montanhas e o mar; quando as lanternas vermelhas se acendem, a vista é encantadora.
translations.hi: जिउफेन पुरानी सड़क समुद्र के सामने पहाड़ों पर बसी है; लाल लालटेन जलने पर रात का दृश्य मनमोहक होता है।
